entities.name: St. Joseph's Church, Beijing
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Joseph's Church, commonly known as Wangfujing Church (王府井天主堂) or Dongtang, is an early 20th-century Romanesque Revival church that is one of the four historic Catholic churches in the Archdiocese of Beijing. It is located in the Dongcheng District of the city at 74 Wangfujing Street.
